meta.scope: Public storefront/product screenshots only. No accounts, gate traversal, forms, personal data, carts, checkout, orders, payment attempts, transactions, credentials, or evasion.
meta.scoring: Scores are 0-10 screenshot-reviewed heuristics for mobile usability, visual polish, product clarity, trust presentation, conversion UX, and a screenshot-capture-time performance proxy. Overall weights match wave B: mobile 15%, visual polish 20%, product clarity 20%, trust 15%, conversion 20%, performance 10%.
meta.disclaimer: UI scores are not evidence of product quality, safety, legality, regulatory compliance, processor durability, revenue, or business scale.
meta.screenshotReview: Both viewport contact sheets were visually reviewed. Gates, challenges, and blank responses were preserved as first-load friction. Hidden content behind an uncrossed gate was excluded from product and conversion scoring. Capture duration is a performance proxy, not Core Web Vitals or DOM-ready timing.

reasons: A browser or connection-security interstitial replaced the storefront in both tested viewports.
